command:
set -e
cd /srv/myapp/app
git fetch origin main -q && git checkout main -q && git pull --ff-only origin main -q
git log -1 --format="HEAD %h %s"
set -a; . /srv/myapp/build.env; set +a
sudo docker build -f Dockerfile.hostvm -t myapp:staging-partlevel \
  --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY="$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY" \
  --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL="$NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL" . 2>&1 | tail -12
echo BUILD_OK

set -e
sudo sed -i "s#image: myapp:staging-parallel#image: myapp:staging-partlevel#" /srv/myapp-staging/docker-compose.yml
grep -n "image:" /srv/myapp-staging/docker-compose.yml
cd /srv/myapp-staging && sudo docker compose up -d --force-recreate 2>&1 | tail -2
sleep 12; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "http %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3001/
sudo docker logs --tail 5 myapp-staging 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /srv/bench; date +%s > /tmp/burst2_start; python3 bench.py 3001 task_start "$(cat /tmp/burst.json)" 300

cd /srv/bench; S=$(cat /tmp/burst2_start); echo "elapsed $(( $(date +%s) - S ))s"; python3 bench.py 3001 task_status "{\"runId\":\"5a1c9e2b-7d3f-4a8b-b6e1-9c0d2f4a6e8b\"}" 400000 > /tmp/b2.json; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open("/tmp/b2.json"))
print("status",d["status"],"total",d["total"],"kept",d["kept"],"rejected",d["rejected"],"failed",d["failed"])
print(Counter(t["status"] for t in d["tasks"]))
print("types",Counter(t["type"] for t in d["tasks"] if t["status"]=="kept"))
c=Counter()
for t in d["tasks"]:
    if t["status"]=="rejected":
        for i in t["issues"]: c[i[:64]]+=1
for k,v in c.most_common(6): print("  ",v,"x",k)
PY

sudo docker logs --tail 60 myapp-staging 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|429|timeout|abort|maxRetries|warn" | tail -12; echo ===; sudo docker stats --no-stream --format "{{.Name}} cpu={{.CPUPerc}} mem={{.MemUsage}}" myapp-staging

set -e
sudo tee /srv/myapp-staging/override.env >/dev/null <<"EOF"
AI_MODEL_SECOND=vendor/model-c-free
AI_MAX_PARALLEL=60
AI_MAX_PARALLEL_PER_PROVIDER=30
GEN_CONCURRENCY=60
MAX_RUN_QUESTIONS=300
EOF
sudo chown 1001:1001 /srv/myapp-staging/override.env; sudo chmod 640 /srv/myapp-staging/override.env
cd /srv/myapp-staging && sudo docker compose up -d --force-recreate 2>&1 | tail -2
sleep 12; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "http %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3001/
sudo docker exec myapp-staging env | grep -E "AI_MAX_PARALLEL|GEN_CONCURRENCY"
cd /srv/bench; date +%s > /tmp/burst3_start; python3 bench.py 3001 task_start "$(cat /tmp/burst.json)" 300

cd /srv/bench; S=$(cat /tmp/burst3_start); echo "elapsed $(( $(date +%s) - S ))s"; python3 bench.py 3001 task_status "{\"runId\":\"6b2d0f3c-8e4a-4b9c-a7f2-0d1e3a5b7c9d\"}" 400000 > /tmp/b3.json; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open("/tmp/b3.json"))
print("status",d["status"],"total",d["total"],"kept",d["kept"],"rejected",d["rejected"],"failed",d["failed"])
print(Counter(t["status"] for t in d["tasks"]))
print("kept types",Counter(t["type"] for t in d["tasks"] if t["status"]=="kept"))
c=Counter()
for t in d["tasks"]:
    if t["status"]=="rejected":
        for i in t["issues"]: c[i[:70]]+=1
for k,v in c.most_common(6): print("  ",v,"x",k)
PY

sudo docker logs --since 8m myapp-staging 2>&1 | grep -ciE "rate_limit|429"; echo "--- errors:"; sudo docker logs --since 8m myapp-staging 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|failed|abort" | tail -5; echo "--- conns:"; sudo docker exec myapp-staging sh -c "cat /proc/net/tcp | wc -l"

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env 2>/dev/null || sudo grep -hE "^(AI_BASE_URL|AI_API_KEY)=" /etc/myapp/myapp.env > /tmp/ai.env; set +a; . /tmp/ai.env
for M in model-a-free model-d-free vendor/model-c-free; do
  code=$(curl -s -m 40 -o /tmp/r.json -w "%{http_code}" "$AI_BASE_URL/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"model\":\"$M\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"say ok\"}],\"max_tokens\":5}")
  echo "$M -> $code $(head -c 110 /tmp/r.json)"
done

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env; set +a
for M in model-b-max model-e-free model-f-free model-g-free model-h-free vendor/model-j-free; do
  code=$(curl -s -m 40 -o /tmp/r.json -w "%{http_code}" "$AI_BASE_URL/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"model\":\"$M\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"say ok\"}],\"max_tokens\":5}")
  echo "$M -> $code $(head -c 80 /tmp/r.json)"
done

set -e
sudo tee /srv/myapp-staging/override.env >/dev/null <<"EOF"
AI_MODEL_CHEAP=vendor/model-j-free
AI_MODEL_SECOND=vendor/model-c-free
AI_MAX_PARALLEL=60

cd /srv/bench; S=$(cat /tmp/burst4_start); echo "elapsed $(( $(date +%s) - S ))s"; python3 bench.py 3001 task_status "{\"runId\":\"7c3e1a4d-9f5b-4c0d-b8a3-1e2f4b6c8d0e\"}" 400000 > /tmp/b4.json; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
from collections import Counter

print("kept types",Counter(t["type"] for t in d["tasks"] if t["status"]=="kept"))

for t in d["tasks"]:

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env; set +a
BODY=$(cat <<JSON
{"model":"MODEL","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Return {\"answer\":\"ok\"}"}],"max_tokens":50,"response_format":{"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"name":"r","strict":true,"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"],"additionalProperties":false}}}}
JSON
)
for M in vendor/model-c-free vendor/model-j-free; do
  code=$(curl -s -m 45 -o /tmp/s.json -w "%{http_code}" "$AI_BASE_URL/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "${BODY/MODEL/$M}")
  echo "$M -> $code $(head -c 130 /tmp/s.json)"
done

set -e
sudo sed -i "s#^AI_MODEL_CHEAP=.*#AI_MODEL_CHEAP=vendor/model-c-free#" /srv/myapp-staging/override.env
cd /srv/myapp-staging && sudo docker compose up -d --force-recreate 2>&1 | tail -1
sleep 12; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "http %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3001/
cd /srv/bench
python3 - <<"PY"
import json
s=json.load(open("/tmp/burst.json"))
json.dump({**s,"nodeIds":s["nodeIds"][:4],"countPerTopic":2},open("/tmp/pilot.json","w"))
print("pilot leaves",4)
PY
date +%s > /tmp/pilot_start
python3 bench.py 3001 task_start "$(cat /tmp/pilot.json)" 300

cd /srv/bench; S=$(cat /tmp/pilot_start); echo "elapsed $(( $(date +%s) - S ))s"; python3 bench.py 3001 task_status "{\"runId\":\"8d4f2b5e-0a6c-4d1e-c9b4-2f3a5c7d9e1f\"}" 400000 > /tmp/p1.json; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open("/tmp/p1.json"))
print("status",d["status"],"total",d["total"],"kept",d["kept"],"rejected",d["rejected"])
print(Counter(t["status"] for t in d["tasks"]), "types kept:",Counter(t["type"] for t in d["tasks"] if t["status"]=="kept"))
for t in d["tasks"]:
    if t["status"]!="kept": print("  REJ",t["type"],"|","; ".join(t["issues"])[:100])
PY

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env; set +a
mk(){ cat <<JSON
{"model":"vendor/model-c-free","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Fill the JSON"}],"max_tokens":60,"response_format":{"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"name":"t","strict":true,"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"figure":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":$1,"properties":{"kind":{"type":"string"}},"required":["kind"]}},"required":["figure"],"additionalProperties":false}}}}
JSON
}
for V in true false; do
  code=$(curl -s -m 45 -o /tmp/t.json -w "%{http_code}" "$AI_BASE_URL/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$(mk $V)")
  echo "additionalProperties=$V -> $code $(head -c 120 /tmp/t.json)"
done
sudo docker logs --since 12m myapp-staging 2>&1 | grep -A6 "Upstream error from provider" | head -20

set -e
cd /srv/myapp/app
git fetch origin main -q && git checkout main -q && git pull --ff-only origin main -q
git log -1 --format="HEAD %h %s"
set -a; . /srv/myapp/build.env; set +a
sudo docker build -f Dockerfile.hostvm -t myapp:staging-partlevel2 \
  --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY="$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY" \
  --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL="$NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL" . 2>&1 | tail -6
echo BUILD_OK

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env; set +a; curl -s -m 60 "$AI_BASE_URL/models" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -o /tmp/models.json -w "http %{http_code} bytes %{size_download}\n"; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
d=json.load(open("/tmp/models.json"))
M=d.get("data") or d.get("models") or []
print("total",len(M))
free=[m for m in M if str(m.get("id","")).endswith(":free") or str(m.get("id","")).endswith("-free")]
print("free-ish",len(free))
for m in free[:60]:
    pid=m.get("id"); pr=m.get("pricing") or {}
    print(" ", pid, "|", {k:v for k,v in pr.items() if k in ("prompt","completion")} or "")
PY

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env; set +a
probe(){ M=$1; MODE=$2
 if [ "$MODE" = plain ]; then B="{\"model\":\"$M\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"say ok\"}],\"max_tokens\":5}";
 else B="{\"model\":\"$M\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Give the JSON {\\\"answer\\\":\\\"ok\\\"}\"}],\"max_tokens\":60,\"response_format\":{\"type\":\"json_schema\",\"json_schema\":{\"name\":\"r\",\"strict\":true,\"schema\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"answer\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"answer\"],\"additionalProperties\":false}}}}"; fi
 T0=$(date +%s%3N); code=$(curl -s -m 60 -o /tmp/pr.json -w "%{http_code}" "$AI_BASE_URL/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$B"); T1=$(date +%s%3N)
 echo "$M [$MODE] -> $code $((T1-T0))ms $(head -c 90 /tmp/pr.json)"
}
for M in model-i-free model-a-free model-d-free; do probe $M plain; probe $M schema; done
for M in vendor/model-k-free vendor/model-l-free; do probe $M plain; probe $M schema; done

set -e
sudo tee /srv/myapp-staging/override.env >/dev/null <<"EOF"
AI_MODEL_CHEAP=vendor/model-k-free
AI_MODEL_SECOND=vendor/model-c-free

sleep 12; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "http %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3001/
cd /srv/bench; date +%s > /tmp/pilot2_start
python3 bench.py 3001 task_start "$(cat /tmp/pilot.json)" 300

cd /srv/bench; S=$(cat /tmp/pilot2_start); echo "elapsed $(( $(date +%s) - S ))s"; python3 bench.py 3001 task_status "{\"runId\":\"9e5a3c6f-1b7d-4e2f-d0c5-3a4b6d8e0f2a\"}" 400000 > /tmp/p2.json; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open("/tmp/p2.json"))
print("status",d["status"],"total",d["total"],"kept",d["kept"],"rejected",d["rejected"])
print(Counter(t["status"] for t in d["tasks"]),"| kept types",Counter(t["type"] for t in d["tasks"] if t["status"]=="kept"))
for t in d["tasks"]:
    if t["status"]!="kept": print("  REJ",t["type"],"|","; ".join(t["issues"])[:110])

for t in d["tasks"]:
    if t["status"]=="rejected": print("  REJ",t["type"],"|","; ".join(t["issues"])[:120])

cd /srv/bench; python3 bench.py 3001 queue_list "{\"slug\":\"bench-synthetic\",\"status\":\"ai_checked\"}" 900000 > /tmp/q2.json; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
d=json.load(open("/tmp/q2.json")); items=d.get("items") or d.get("questions") or []
items.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("createdAt") or "", reverse=True)
print("queue total",len(items))
for q in items[:4]:
    print("="*60)
    print(q["type"], q["marks"],"marks | modelAnswer:", (q.get("modelAnswer") or "NONE")[:90].replace("\n"," "))
    print("stem:", q["stem"][:160].replace("\n"," "))
    pts=q["markScheme"].get("points") or []
    print("scheme points:", len(pts), "total", sum(p.get("marks",0) for p in pts))
    parts=q.get("parts")
    print("parts:", "NONE" if not parts else len(parts))
    for p in (parts or []):
        print("   ",p.get("label"), p.get("marks"),"m | cw:",p.get("commandWord"),"| fmt:",p.get("format"),"| sol:",bool(p.get("solution")),"| spec:",bool(p.get("specNodeId")),"| src:",p.get("source"),"| ai:",p.get("isAiAssisted"))
PY
